operators.name: upsample_bilinear2d
semantics: Performs bilinear upsampling identical to torch.nn.UpsamplingBilinear2d with align_corners=False (default).
For each output pixel (oh, ow), computes source coordinates as (oh + 0.5) / scale_factor - 0.5 = (oh + 0.5) * 0.5 - 0.5.
Clamps source coordinates to [0, H-1] and [0, W-1].
Performs bilinear interpolation using four neighboring input pixels.
Supports any input shape with H, W >= 1; scale_factor integer >= 1.
Preserves input dtype and device; output is CUDA float32 tensor.
Applies bilinear upsampling with scale_factor=2 to input x.
No additional operations; result is returned directly.
